paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter using solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance
notes: Paper reports EDM coupling limit |g_d| < 9.5×10^-4 GeV^-2 over frequency range 39.1–40.2 MHz, corresponding to ALP mass range 162–166 neV. This converts to oscillating neutron EDM amplitude bound of 1.0×10^-21 e·cm and CP-violating θ parameter amplitude of 4.3×10^-6. The paper also reports gradient coupling limit |g_aNN| < 2.8×10^-1 GeV^-1 but primary result is EDM coupling. Mass range derived from Compton frequency ν_a = m_a c^2/h: 39.1 MHz → 162 neV, 40.2 MHz → 166 neV. DM density ρ_DM = 3.6×10^-42 GeV^4 is standard halo assumption used in paper. Confidence level is 95% as stated.
